mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right small-group training program for my fitness goals?

acceptedAnswer.text: To choose the right small-group training program, consider your current fitness level, specific goals (e.g., strength, endurance, weight loss), and any physical limitations. A preparation step involves discussing these factors with our Cave Training coaches during an initial consultation. They can help assess your needs and recommend a program that aligns with what you want to achieve, ensuring a good fit for your individual journey.
